resources.string: Set up or choose a Worker
Set up a new Worker or Pages deployment
Traffic exits through the selected Worker. Choose another connection method to configure an exit node.
Import a subscription or profiles such as VLESS, VMess, Trojan and Shadowsocks. Filter by protocol and select an imported or cached node before connecting.
Paste a proxy profile to choose a node here. Connect once to load a new subscription.
Independent VLESS connection: Normal, Fragment or Browser Dialer.
Connect directly through your VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks or other imported nodes.
Android VPN permission was not granted. Your Worker is saved; tap Connect to try again.
Android could not start the VPN service. Try again while this screen is open.
No browser could open the token page.
Deploy and manage your own TCP proxy on Workers or Pages.
The API token stays in memory while this screen is open. Paste it again next time.

The form prefills deployment permissions plus Zone: Read and DNS: Edit for custom domains, and Account Analytics: Read for usage. Review Account Resources and Zone Resources, select your account and zones, then create and paste the token.
This Worker serves VLESS over WebSocket. VMess, Trojan and other server profiles belong in Proxy profiles.

Clean IPs or domains · one per line
443, 8443, 2053, 2083, 2087, 2096. Best Ping tests the selected addresses and ports.
ECH DNS · HTTPS or TCP URL
Custom CDN addresses · one per line
An additional way to reach Cloudflare. This is separate from the proxy IPs used by the Worker to reach destination websites.
Worker proxy IPs or domains · one per line
Lengths are bytes; delays are milliseconds. Enter ranges such as 100-200, 50-100. Fragment mode uses its own TLS connection, without ECH, custom CDN or the upstream relay.
Packets · tlshello or a range such as 1-3

Android WebView opens the secure WebSocket using its browser TLS stack. This mode uses the deployment domain on port 443; clean IPs, fingerprint, ECH, fragments and CDN settings apply to the other modes.
Disconnect this Worker before saving. Connection settings apply next time you connect. Changing proxy IPs or the fallback website also redeploys the Worker and needs the API token.
Use a domain in this Cloudflare account. Attach creates its route and DNS record; existing website records are kept. Certificate activation may take time. Detach returns to the deployment hostname.
Domain setup is incomplete. Retry or detach it; connections still use the deployment hostname.
Requests over the last 24 hours — account: %1$d; this Worker: %2$d. Cloudflare analytics may be sampled.
A private proxy on a workers.dev hostname.
A private proxy on a pages.dev hostname.

Used only when a destination refuses Worker connections, such as sites behind Cloudflare. When blank, or when the relay fails, the Worker uses public NAT64 gateways; they see destination addresses but not encrypted content. Only enter a relay you trust.
Setup incomplete. Retry or delete this deployment.
Delete %1$s from Cloudflare? This removes its remote proxy. Disconnect the VPN first.
TCP only. Connecting uses this Worker directly, changes the current connection method, and keeps your existing nodes and identity. Your network can see the Worker hostname.
This screen manages deployments created on this device. Connection identities stay in app-private storage; API tokens are never saved. Cloudflare plan limits still apply.
